steps: Define an explicit case-insensitive set of sensitive field names and one stable replacement marker.
Recursively copy mappings and arrays; replace values whose field name is sensitive, and preserve all other scalar values.
Reject non-mapping roots and non-string mapping keys rather than guessing how to serialize them.
Document that field-name redaction does not detect secrets embedded in free text.
method.summary: Create a non-mutating, field-name redactor for JSON-like agent audit events.
verification: Sensitive fields are redacted at the root and inside nested mappings and arrays.
Non-sensitive fields are unchanged and the input object is not mutated.
Invalid root values and mapping keys fail explicitly.
